newsitem.title: USA: Case gets $80 million Uzbekistan order.
newsitem.headline: Case gets $80 million Uzbekistan order.

text.p: Case Corp, an agricultural and constructiuon equipment maker, said Monday that Uzbekistan has purchased about $80 million of Case IH agricultural equipment, the company's largest sale to date to the growing Central Asian agricultural equipment market.

The purchase, made by Uzbekistan's procurement and distribution agency, Uzselkhozsnabremont, includes 400 Case IH Magnum high-horsepower tractors, 200 Case IH Axial-Flow combines and 400 Case IH 165 model plows, Case said.
Case will also supply product support, including training local technicians on equipment service.
